segments.text: Everyone's been asking me for my skin care routine, and I'm going to share it with you, but the number one thing that I've done for my skin has actually been micro dosing Accutane. So, this is something that's specific to me and my skin, but I've [music] always struggled with acne. It's been something I haven't been able to deal with with any other way. And so, for me, the thing that made the biggest difference is taking Accutane. Now, I didn't do a full dose like people typically do, which has really large consequences for their skin. Like, often times you'll see people get really dry. I do a micro dose, which is one pill once a week, which is 40 [music] mg of dose. Now, this is not for everyone. Accutane is a

very serious prescription medication, and any changes to your lifestyle should be run by a doctor. It may not be right for you. You may not have the same oily skin that I have, but for me, at age 30 with a skinny age of 21, this has made the biggest difference to my skin care. So, if you also struggle with acne, but haven't really want to take a full dose of Accutane, it may work for you, too.
Talk to your doctor and see what options you have available.
